{{Location infobox | image = [[Image:Beknur Harbor.jpg|196px]] | campaign = Nightfall | region = Istan | type = Outpost | exits = [[Cliffs of Dohjok]]
[[Issnur Isles]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | rune trader = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Beknur Harbor world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Beknur Harbor inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} [[Beknur Harbor]] is the entrance to the southeastern portion of the island of [[Istan]], populated by hardy folk tempered by the dangers of the southeastern lands and from many [[corsair]] raids. {{Quotation|game| Life in Beknur Harbor is harsh, but you won't hear the villagers complain. Surrounded by [[corsairs]] and all manner of beasts and roaming [[plant|plants]], these hardy folk still find a way to scrape a living farming ironreed in the local ponds and fishing the open sea. The [[Issnur Isles]] east of the village were once part of the [[Mehtani Keys]], but years of silt brought in during storms formed land bridges, allowing the local wildlife to flourish and roam the [[Istan|region]]. }} ==Getting there== Beknur Harbor lies in the southeastern corner of the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]]. The [[primary quest]] [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]] will lead [[characters]] through here. [[Nightfall]] characters are forbidden from entering this outpost until they have acquired that quest (which comes after the [[Jokanur Diggings]] mission).
